```{r}
library(readr)
data <- read_csv("C:/Users/Hype/Downloads/waktu tunggu perpustakaan - Sheet1.csv")
View(data)
```

```{r}
# Plot untuk Arrival Rate per Hour
ggplot(arrival_rate_per_hour, aes(x = Hour, y = arrival_rate)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Arrival Rate per Hour",
       x = "Hour",
       y = "Arrival Rate (per minute)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot untuk Utilisasi (P)
ggplot(arrival_rate_per_hour, aes(x = Hour, y = P)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Utilization (P) per Hour",
       x = "Hour",
       y = "Utilization (P %)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot untuk Lq (Jumlah Pengunjung dalam Antrian)
ggplot(arrival_rate_per_hour, aes(x = Hour, y = Lq)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Average Number of Visitors in Queue (Lq)",
       x = "Hour",
       y = "Number of Visitors in Queue (Lq)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot untuk Wq (Waktu Tunggu dalam Antrian)
ggplot(arrival_rate_per_hour, aes(x = Hour, y = Wq)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Average Wait Time in Queue (Wq)",
       x = "Hour",
       y = "Wait Time in Queue (Wq) [hours]") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot untuk Ls (Jumlah Pengunjung dalam Sistem)
ggplot(arrival_rate_per_hour, aes(x = Hour, y = Ls)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Average Number of Visitors in System (Ls)",
       x = "Hour",
       y = "Number of Visitors in System (Ls)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot untuk Ws (Waktu dalam Sistem)
ggplot(arrival_rate_per_hour, aes(x = Hour, y = Ws)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Average Time in System (Ws)",
       x = "Hour",
       y = "Time in System (Ws) [hours]") +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

# ======================
# 1. Preprocessing
# ======================

data$Timestamp <- as.POSIXct(data$Timestamp,
                             format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S")

data$Hour <- floor_date(data$Timestamp, unit = "hour")

# ======================
# 2. Hitung arrival rate per jam (λ per jam)
# ======================

arrival_rate_per_hour <- data %>%
  group_by(Hour) %>%
  summarise(arrival_rate = n(), .groups = "drop")

service_rate <- 12   # μ

# ======================
# 3. Hitung metrik M/M/1 per jam per hari
# ======================

arrival_rate_per_hour <- arrival_rate_per_hour %>%
  mutate(
    P  = arrival_rate / service_rate,
    Lq = ifelse(arrival_rate < service_rate,
                (arrival_rate^2) / (service_rate * (service_rate - arrival_rate)),
                NA_real_),
    Wq = ifelse(arrival_rate < service_rate,
                arrival_rate / (service_rate * (service_rate - arrival_rate)),
                NA_real_),
    Ls = ifelse(arrival_rate < service_rate,
                arrival_rate / (service_rate - arrival_rate),
                NA_real_),
    Ws = ifelse(arrival_rate < service_rate,
                1 / (service_rate - arrival_rate),
                NA_real_)
  )

print(arrival_rate_per_hour)

# ======================
# 4. Hitung rata-rata per jam (gabungan banyak hari)
# ======================

avg_by_hour <- arrival_rate_per_hour %>%
  mutate(HourOfDay = format(Hour, "%H:%M")) %>%
  group_by(HourOfDay) %>%
  summarise(mean_arrival_rate = mean(arrival_rate),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    P  = mean_arrival_rate / service_rate,
    Lq = ifelse(mean_arrival_rate < service_rate,
                (mean_arrival_rate^2) / (service_rate * (service_rate - mean_arrival_rate)),
                NA_real_),
    Wq = ifelse(mean_arrival_rate < service_rate,
                mean_arrival_rate / (service_rate * (service_rate - mean_arrival_rate)),
                NA_real_),
    Ls = ifelse(mean_arrival_rate < service_rate,
                mean_arrival_rate / (service_rate - mean_arrival_rate),
                NA_real_),
    Ws = ifelse(mean_arrival_rate < service_rate,
                1 / (service_rate - mean_arrival_rate),
                NA_real_)
  )

print(avg_by_hour)

# ======================
# 5. Plot Arrival Rate Per Hari
# ======================

ggplot(arrival_rate_per_hour, aes(x = Hour, y = arrival_rate)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Arrival Rate per Jam",
    x = "Jam",
    y = "Jumlah Kedatangan per Jam"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# ======================
# 6. Plot Rata-rata Arrival Rate per Jam (gabungan hari)
# ======================

ggplot(avg_by_hour, aes(x = HourOfDay, y = mean_arrival_rate, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Rata-rata Arrival Rate per Jam (Gabungan Banyak Hari)",
    x = "Jam",
    y = "Rata-rata Kedatangan per Jam"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
